title: Authentication flow
content: Generated 2026-10-13. Facebook Login OAuth: dialog/oauth with scope -> code -> short-lived user token -> fb_exchange_token long-lived token (60 days) -> GET /me/accounts for Page token and instagram_business_account.id as ig-user-id. See docs/authentication.md.

title: Get IG user profile
content: Generated 2026-10-13. GET /{ig-user-id}?fields=id,username,media_count,followers_count with user/Page token. Returns IgUser. No account_type field exists on current versions. Requires instagram_basic.

title: List media
content: Generated 2026-10-13. GET /{ig-user-id}/media?fields=id,caption,media_type,media_url,permalink,timestamp&limit=25. Paginate via paging.cursors.after.

title: Create media container (publish step 1)
content: Generated 2026-10-13. POST image_url or video_url (+ media_type=REELS/CAROUSEL/STORIES, caption). Returns container id. Requires instagram_content_publish. Public HTTPS asset URL required.

title: Get container status
content: Generated 2026-10-13. GET /{container-id}?fields=status_code,status. Poll videos until FINISHED; ERROR/EXPIRED require recreate. Unpublished containers expire in ~24h.

title: Publish container (publish step 2)
content: Generated 2026-10-13. POST creation_id={container-id}. Returns published media id. Check quota via GET /{ig-user-id}/content_publishing_limit.

title: Account insights
content: Generated 2026-10-13. GET /{ig-user-id}/insights?metric=reach,views,accounts_engaged&period=day&since&until. Requires instagram_manage_insights. Do not use impressions (dropped v22+), profile_views, or website_clicks (removed); use views/profile_links_taps.

title: Media insights
content: Generated 2026-10-13. GET /{media-id}/insights?metric=views,reach,saved,shares. No engagement metric; plays deprecated (use views). Unavailable for media inside carousel albums. One invalid metric fails the call (error 100).

title: List and reply to comments
content: Generated 2026-10-13. GET /{media-id}/comments; POST /{comment-id}/replies with message; POST /{comment-id} hide=true; DELETE /{comment-id}. Requires instagram_manage_comments.

title: Send Instagram message
content: Generated 2026-10-13. POST recipient.id=IGSID, message.text (<=1000 bytes), messaging_type=RESPONSE within 24h window; MESSAGE_TAG outside it where allowed. FB Login: Page ID + Page token on graph.facebook.com; IG Login: IG ID on graph.instagram.com. Requires instagram_manage_messages. IGSIDs come from webhooks only.

title: Webhooks verify and events
content: Generated 2026-10-13. GET: return hub.challenge when hub.mode=subscribe and hub.verify_token matches. POST: object=instagram, entry[].changes (comments/mentions) or messaging[] (messages). Validate X-Hub-Signature-256, return 200 fast, dedupe.

title: Errors and rate limits
content: Generated 2026-10-13. 190 token invalid (re-auth), 10/200 permission, 100 bad param, 4/17/32 throttling (back off), 613 publishing quota. Retry only transient errors with exponential backoff. See docs/errors-and-rate-limits.md.

title: Two API flavors (Facebook Login vs Instagram Login)
content: Generated 2026-10-13. Facebook Login: graph.facebook.com, EAA Page token, linked Page required. Instagram Login: graph.instagram.com, IGAA user token, no Page. Same path shapes, different host/token/scopes (instagram_* vs instagram_business_*). Never mix. See INSTAGRAM_GRAPH_API.md section 1.

title: Toggle comments / delete media
content: Generated 2026-10-13. Captions cannot be edited via the API. POST /{media-id}?comment_enabled=true|false is the only update (requires instagram_manage_comments). DELETE /{media-id} permanently deletes (Facebook Login only, requires instagram_manage_contents; carousels deleted as whole albums; response includes deleted_id).

title: Carousel children
content: Generated 2026-10-13. GET /{media-id}/children?fields=id,media_type,media_url lists album items. Requires instagram_basic.

title: List active stories
content: Generated 2026-10-13. GET /{ig-user-id}/stories?fields=id,media_type,media_url,timestamp. Stories expire after 24h; fetch story insights while live. Requires instagram_basic.

title: Publishing quota
content: Generated 2026-10-13. GET fields=quota_usage,rate_limit_settings. Limit: 100 API-published posts per rolling 24h (carousels count as one) and 400 containers created per rolling 24h. Check before queueing scheduled posts.

title: Publish carousel
content: Generated 2026-10-13. Per-item containers with is_carousel_item=true, then parent media_type=CAROUSEL with children=C1,C2 + caption, then media_publish the PARENT id. Video items must be FINISHED first.

title: Publish story
content: Generated 2026-10-13. Container with media_type=STORIES + image_url (or video_url, then poll FINISHED), then media_publish. Stickers not settable via API.

title: Hashtag search
content: Generated 2026-10-13. GET /ig_hashtag_search?user_id={ig-user-id}&q=name resolves tag to hashtag ID. Then /{hashtag-id}/top_media or /recent_media with user_id + fields. Only public Business/Creator media returned.

title: Business Discovery lookup
content: Generated 2026-10-13. business_discovery.username(target){id,username,followers_count,media.limit(n){...}} looks up another professional account without their token. Rate-limit aggressively.

title: Tagged media
content: Generated 2026-10-13. GET /{ig-user-id}/tags?fields=id,caption,media_type,permalink&limit=25. Facebook Login flavor is the reliable one for tags; verify IG Login behavior per version.

title: Block/unblock user (Moderate Conversations)
content: Generated 2026-10-13. POST JSON {user_ids:[{id:IGSID}], actions:[block_user|unblock_user|move_to_spam]} with Page token. Requires instagram_manage_messages + business_management and an existing conversation. Max 10 IDs, 2 actions. Gate behind human approval.

title: List conversations
content: Generated 2026-10-13. IG Login: GET /{ig-user-id}/conversations (or /me/conversations, ?user_id=IGSID). FB Login: GET /{page-id}/conversations?platform=instagram with Page token. Then GET /{conversation-id}?fields=messages{id,message,from,created_time}. Requires instagram_manage_messages.

title: Message tags outside 24h window
content: Generated 2026-10-13. Outside 24h use messaging_type=MESSAGE_TAG + approved tag (e.g. HUMAN_AGENT). Log every tagged send. Misuse restricts the account.

title: oEmbed public post
content: Generated 2026-10-13. GET /instagram_oembed?url={post-url}&fields=author_name,html,thumbnail_url renders a public post. Auth requirements vary by version; fall back to GET /{media-id} with token.

title: Verify token and scopes
content: Generated 2026-10-13. GET ?input_token={token}&access_token={app-id}|{app-secret}. Gate connections on is_valid=true + required scopes. expires_at 0 = non-expiring Page token.

title: Subscribe webhook fields
content: Generated 2026-10-13. POST subscribed_fields=comments,messages,mentions with Page token (FB Login flavor). Re-subscribe after token/app changes. List via GET /{app-id}/subscriptions with app token.

title: Cursor pagination pattern
content: Generated 2026-10-13. Walk paging.next / cursors.after until absent. limit default 25, use <=50 defensively. Shared pages() helpers in INSTAGRAM_GRAPH_API.md section 5.3.
